Class UcsbQuarterService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.UcsbQuarterService
@Service public class UcsbQuarterService extends Object
Derives the last quarter the admin Courses dropdowns should offer, from the quarter UCSB says it currently is. Only app.startQtrYYYYQ needs configuring; the end of the range keeps itself up to date as quarters roll over.

The rule is ported from proj-courses' UCSBAPIQuarterService: look ahead one quarter, except in Spring, when look ahead two so that both Summer and Fall are offered.

      public List<UCSBAPIQuarter> loadQuarters(String startYYYYQ, String endYYYYQ) throws Exception
      Saves every quarter of the calendar from startYYYYQ to endYYYYQ inclusive, overwriting what is on file, and returns them oldest first (issue #151). Quarters outside the range are left alone, so nothing on file is ever removed.

    • getCurrentQuarterYYYYQ

      public String getCurrentQuarterYYYYQ() throws Exception
      The quarter UCSB says it currently is, in YYYYQ form. Cached for 24 hours: this is asked for on every /api/systemInfo call, and the answer changes a handful of times a year.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • getEndQtrYYYYQ

      public String getEndQtrYYYYQ()
      The end of the range for the quarter dropdowns. Falls back to app.endQtrYYYYQ if the UCSB API is unreachable or returns something unusable, so a bad upstream degrades the range rather than breaking the page.
